name: codegraph-ide-vscode
description: Python-first codebase intelligence extension for VS Code and Cursor.

codegraph.liveExplain.enabled.markdownDescription: When on, Codegraph auto-explains the current cursor/selection as you navigate (no Command Palette each time). Toggle via **Codegraph: Toggle Live Explain Mode** or the status bar.

codegraph.liveExplain.debounceMs.description: Delay after cursor/selection changes before live explain runs (higher is better for Agent auto-submit).

codegraph.liveExplain.autoSubmitAgent.markdownDescription: In Agent mode, automatically open/focus Agent chat, paste grounded context, and submit (no manual Enter). On macOS this uses Accessibility automation.

codegraph.liveExplain.pythonOnly.description: Only auto-explain when the active editor is a Python file.

codegraph.liveExplain.writeAgentBridge.markdownDescription: When Live Explain is on, write cursor state to `~/.cursor/codegraph/` (`enabled`, `state.json`, `wake.log`, `pending-prompt.md`) so a watcher/skill can wake Cursor Agent — same pattern as learn-codebase.

codegraph.liveExplain.compatLearnCodebas.markdownDescription: Also mirror bridge files to `~/.cursor/learn-codebase/` so an existing learn-codebase watcher keeps working.

codegraph.modelAccess.useBuiltInAgent.markdownDescription: Use **built-in Cursor/Claude agent** for generative enrichment. Live Explain fills the same sections (summary, what it does, purpose/use, how, usages) via the agent bridge/watcher.

codegraph.modelAccess.useApiKeyProvider.markdownDescription: Use an **API key provider** for in-panel enrichment of the same sections during Live Explain and one-shot Explain.

codegraph.explain.depth.markdownDescription: How detailed Live Explain / Agent / API enrichment answers should be.

codegraph.modelAccess.autoEnrichOnExplai.markdownDescription: After a **manual** Explain Selection, auto-hand off to Cursor/Claude agent. Does **not** fire on every Live Explain cursor move (that would spam chat).

codegraph.enrichment.enabled.description: Legacy: enable optional model-backed explanation enrichment.

codegraph.enrichment.preferIdeHost.markdownDescription: When API key mode is on, try IDE host language models (`vscode.lm`) **before** the configured API provider. Leave off to always use your selected provider (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.).

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter — Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and more
codegraph.enrichment.provider.markdownDescription: API enrichment provider. Base URL is set automatically (except **Custom**).

codegraph.enrichment.apiKey.description: API key for the selected enrichment provider.

codegraph.enrichment.model.markdownDescription: Model id for the selected provider (e.g. `openai/gpt-4o-mini`, `anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `gemini-2.0-flash`).

codegraph.enrichment.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Only needed when provider is **Custom**. Known providers set this automatically.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && mkdir -p ../../artifacts && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../artifacts/codegraph-extension.vsix
